subject: Activation phasing + exceptions: decision window and docs handoff
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-analytics.com>, Priya Raman <priya.r@brightcloud.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation phasing + exceptions: decision window and docs handoff

Team — initiating a short thread to lock the activation phasing for the Acme pilot and call out any exception paths we need to unblock. Key constraints: internal enablement slots, support coverage for cohort 1, and two lingering exceptions in the security questionnaire that Acme flagged.

Quick summary of what I need from this group by EOD PST today:
- Product (Ben/Karthik): confirm which features must be in cohort 1 vs. deferred to cohort 2 (matrix attached).
- Enablement (Marissa/Vanessa): confirm training availability and a concise enablement outline we can share with the customer.
- Ops/Eng (Michael): confirm we can guarantee the rolling-window throughput for cohort 1 and whether any infra exceptions are required.

Attached: activation-matrix-v1.xlsx (columns: feature, must-have? owner, risk, estimated rollout impact).

If we don't make a decision today we risk slipping the customer kickoff by two weeks. Jordan & Priya — appreciate any immediate constraints on your side for a small initial cohort (100 users).

Thanks,
Mateo
Product Strategy | Redwood Inference
---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2029 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation phasing + exceptions: decision window and docs handoff

Mateo — thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers and a couple of questions below.

- Training: we can run two 90-minute enablement sessions the week of 7/22 (Mon/Tue). Need final feature list by 7/12 COB to build slides and hands-on labs.
- Customer-facing enablement doc: I'll draft a 1-pager + detailed agenda (enablement-outline.docx) if we confirm cohort 1 scope. Expect a first draft by 7/13.
- Support rota: Vanessa will own Tier 1 for cohort 1 and needs a 5-day overlap with Eng on the first week post-activation.

Questions for Product:
1) Are there any known quality/regression risks if we defer the 'semantic filtering' UI to cohort 2? That item is currently marked "maybe" in the attached matrix.
2) Are we comfortable with a phased rollout by region? Acme asked for US-only first; if we do region gating, we'll need a short-runbook for ops.

On the exceptions: Jordan, can you re-share the two security items you flagged so we can prioritize internal signoffs?

Marissa
Product Enablement | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation phasing + exceptions: decision window and docs handoff

Short + direct:
- Must-haves for cohort 1: core inference API, user mapping, consent banner, and the reporting endpoints. Those are non-negotiable.
- Defer: semantic filtering UI and advanced reranking to cohort 2. We can provide a fixed configuration in cohort 1 to approximate filtering behavior.

If product doesn't lock these today, we should default to conservative scope (defer UI) to meet the kickoff date.

Ben
Senior PM, Product

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-analytics.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Raman <priya.r@brightcloud.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2029 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation phasing + exceptions: decision window and docs handoff

Thanks for pulling this together — Acme is fine with a phased approach as long as the initial cohort includes the core inference API + reporting (those are our top priorities). We can accept deferred UI work as long as the behavior is configurable.

On the two security items:
- Data residency: we'd like a written note confirming US-only data residency for cohort 1 (is that feasible?).
- Audit log sampling: we need a short-runbook that shows how we will surface audit logs for the pilot.

We can sign a narrow exception for the audit-log sampling if Redwood provides a documented process and a timeline to deliver full sampling for cohort 2. Happy to take the 1-pager enablement doc once Marissa has it.

Jordan Ellis
Director, Platform Integrations | Acme Analytics

Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2029 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation phasing + exceptions: decision window and docs handoff — final decisions + owners

Quick wrap and owners based on the thread so we can proceed with enablement work and customer comms: 

Decisions (agreed):
- Cohort 1 scope: core inference API, reporting endpoints, user mapping, consent banner (Ben owner). Semantic filtering UI deferred to cohort 2 with a config-only surface for cohort 1 (Ben to deliver config spec by 7/12 COB).
- Region gating: US-only for cohort 1; Ops runbook required (Michael owner) — Michael to provide a short runbook and confirm data residency controls by 7/15.
- Enablement: Marissa to deliver enablement-outline.docx draft by 7/13 and schedule two training sessions the week of 7/22. Vanessa to provision Tier 1 support rota with 5-day Eng overlap.
- Security exceptions: provide a written note on US-only residency (Ops/Legal) and an audit-log sampling runbook (Karthik to coordinate with Priya). Karthik — please capture the exception agreement and target full sampling in cohort 2.

Action items & links:
- Ben: config spec for semantic filtering (due 2029-07-12 COB)
- Michael: US-only runbook + residency confirmation (due 2029-07-15)
- Marissa: enablement-outline.docx draft + training schedule (due 2029-07-13)
- Karthik: exception note & sampling runbook coordination with Priya (due 2029-07-15)

Related artifacts:
- Activation matrix (attached): activation-matrix-v1.xlsx
- Enablement draft link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-activation-plan
- Tracker: JIRA-RED-4521

If anyone disagrees with the decisions above, raise it now — otherwise I will send a customer-facing confirmation to Jordan tomorrow morning and lock training invites.

Thanks for the quick turn,
Mateo
Product Strategy | Redwood Inference

Attachments: enablement-outline.docx, activation-matrix-v1.xlsx
